name: Infigratinib Phosphate

examples.title: Oral Infigratinib for the Adjuvant Treatment of Subjects With Invasive Urothelial Carcinoma With Susceptible FGFR3 Genetic Alterations
examples.why: The sponsor has decided to close the study due to the discontinuation of infigratinib development. The discontinuation of the study was not due to safety reasons.

summary: A small computer model, not tested on people, gave Infigratinib Phosphate a high risk score of 76 for liver issues and a low risk score of 43 for heart issues [M]. The provided records list no specific problems or official warnings for the drug from the Food and Drug Administration [1][2]. Additionally, an example human study was closed because the sponsor decided to stop developing the drug, rather than because of any safety concerns [4].
